bio.text: Tim Kennedy represents New York's 26th Congressional District and was elected to the House on April 30, 2024.
Before Congress he represented Western New York in the New York State Senate, where he chaired the Transportation Committee.
A Buffalo native, he earned bachelor's and master's degrees in occupational therapy from D'Youville College and worked as an occupational therapist for 11 years.
